newsitem.title: USA: Acutek issues response to CNS statement.
newsitem.headline: Acutek issues response to CNS statement.

text.p: A company involved in a dispute with CNS Inc, maker of the Breathe Right nasal dilator strip, said Thursday it remains confident it may be able to capture a large share of the nasal dilator market.
Privately held Acutek Adhesive Specialties Inc, of Inglewood, Calif., said it issued the statement in response to a statement made early Thursday by CNS.

In response to the Acutek statement, a CNS spokesman late Thursday said the company will sue Acutek if it attempts to market an external nasal dilator in the United States. He said CNS is confident in the Breathe Right's patent protection.

Acutek said it expects to be able "to control the manufacture, sales , distribution and/or license of nasal dilators in the United States." That expectation is based on the reissuance last month of a patent, it said.

"With its international patent filings in place, Acutek also believes it will have the right to control the manufacture, sales, distribution and/or license of nasal dilators in various international marketplaces," Acutek said.
